title: The conormal sequence of an immersion of algebraic spaces over a base space
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For an immersion of algebraic spaces over a base algebraic space, the lemma produces a canonical right exact sequence relating the conormal sheaf of the immersion, the pullback of the differentials of the ambient morphism, and the differentials of the immersion. The proof works on an etale chart, applies the schemes-side conormal sequence for an immersion there, and then descends the sequence back using compatibility of conormal sheaves and differentials with etale localisation. The descent through the chart is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 1157-1177.
